goal: Decide whether a Prism dataflow project script is accepted, rejected with policy findings, or an error, so a project that breaks its memory or PII-encryption policy never reads as accepted.

app.name: dataflow-policy-check
app.title: Dataflow policy
app.purpose: Decide the status of a dataflow-policy/1 script from its size in bytes, whether every line parsed, how many nodes exceed the memory policy and how many outputs personal data reaches unencrypted.
limits: It does not parse the script; the parse field says whether every line was read and applied, and the first failing line's code is the CLI's to print.
It does not decide response too-large, the error a report longer than 16384 bytes is replaced by.

fields.name: bytes
fields.means: the length of the request in bytes

fields.name: parse
fields.means: whether the header and every statement line parsed and applied, or a line failed with its typed code

fields.name: excess
fields.means: nodes whose memory requirement exceeds the policy memory limit (0 with no memory policy)

fields.name: exposed
fields.means: output nodes personal data reaches without an encrypt node, under policy encrypt-pii (0 without it)

meanings.accepted: status accepted, then the canonical sorted project; exit 0
meanings.rejected: status rejected, then every finding and the canonical project; exit 1
meanings.error: status error with the request code or the first failing line and its code; exit 2

rules.why: src/Specification.lex.tex: an empty request answers status error, request empty
src/Specification.lex.tex: a request over 4096 bytes answers request too-large
src/Engine.lex.tex runLines: the first line that fails to parse or apply ends the run as Outcome.Failed
src/Compliance.lex.tex memoryFindings: each node above the limit is a MemoryExceeded finding
src/Compliance.lex.tex piiFindings: each output reached by unencrypted personal data is a PlaintextPii finding

app.otherwiseWhy: src/Engine.lex.tex certifyWith: a parsed project with no findings is Outcome.Accepted

properties.why: Engine.failedRunNeverAccepted: a failed run is never accepted
Engine.completedRunAcceptedOnlyIfCompliant: a node over its memory limit is not compliant
Engine.completedRunAcceptedOnlyIfCompliant: plaintext personal data at an output is not compliant
the request bound of 4096 bytes is checked before any line is read

stakeholders.name: Script author
stakeholders.text: Writes Prism dataflow project scripts and needs the status line to say whether the project meets its declared policies.

stakeholders.name: Data protection reviewer
stakeholders.text: Relies on an accepted project never sending personal data to an output in plaintext.

concerns.name: No plaintext personal data accepted
concerns.text: Under policy encrypt-pii, a project in which personal data reaches an output without an encrypt node is never accepted.

components.name: dataflow-policy CLI
components.text: The command line PrismPM generates from the prismpm/text-application/3 record: dataflow-policy check [FILE].

components.name: Dataflow Policy workbench
components.text: The verified browser application on GitHub Pages that checks a script in the page.

threats.name: PII finding suppressed
threats.text: A project whose personal data reaches an output unencrypted is reported accepted, and the data ships in plaintext.

control.name: Findings rule out acceptance
control.text: Any PlaintextPii finding rules out accepted, proved for every request.

threats.name: Oversized script exhausts the checker
threats.text: A very large script makes the checker allocate without bound.

control.name: Request bound
control.text: A request over 4096 bytes is answered error before any line is read.

threats.name: PII label omitted
threats.text: A script author leaves out a pii line, so the policy never sees personal data on that input.
threats.accepted: Labelling personal data is the script author's statement; the checker decides from the script it is given and prints the canonical project for review.

quality.text: No request with a memory or PII finding, or a failed line, is accepted.
quality.measureText: Acceptance vectors answered accepted while excess or exposed is at least 1 or parse is fault.

quality.text: Each vector answers the status the prism-code model gives.
quality.measureText: Acceptance vectors whose replayed status differs from the expected one.
